items.text: “O G-d, save me for the sake of Your Name. Impose Your judgment for me with Your power.” Ask Hashem to save you through the power of the Name Hashem representing His kindness [--- ]
items.title: KINDNESS
HEAR MY TEFILLOS
items.quote: O G-d, hear my prayer. Listen to the words of my mouth..
items.text: Ask Hashem to listen to your tefillos whether spoken or unspoken.

items.title: LOYALTY
items.quote: I see G-d is helping me; my L-rd [is helping me] through those who support me.
items.text: Thank Hashem for the loyalty of the people who have helped you in times of difficulty.

items.title: DEVOTION
items.quote: I will offer sacrifices to You with devotion. I will give thanks to Your Name, Hashem, for it is good.
items.text: Thank Hashem with sincerity and devotion for the times He saved you.

items.quote: For He has rescued me from every trouble. My eye has gazed upon my foes.
